com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.impl
Default implementation of the com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client API.
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.impl.membervisitors
PlanTypeWalker.Visitor implementations that collect members matching a MemberSearchQuery while walking a plan type's dimension hierarchy, in support of PbcsPlanType.searchMembers(com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.MemberSearchQuery).
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.util
Public utility classes for working with grids and plan type dimensions: printing and diffing data slices (GridPrinter, DataSliceDiff), walking a dimension hierarchy (PlanTypeWalker), and building test fixtures or sample connections (TextGridReader, PbcsClientUtils).

    Class
    Description
    class 
    AbstractMemberVisitor
    Base class for PlanTypeWalker.Visitor implementations that collect members matching the criteria of a MemberSearchQuery while walking a plan type's dimension hierarchy.
    class 
    SearchMemberVisitor
    A AbstractMemberVisitor that matches members whose name or alias is exactly equal to the search query's search term.
    class 
    SearchRegexMemberVisitor
    A AbstractMemberVisitor that matches members whose name or alias fully matches a regular expression built from the search query's search term.
    class 
    SearchWildMemberVisitor
    A SearchRegexMemberVisitor that treats the search query's search term as a simple wildcard pattern, where * matches any sequence of characters.
